messages:
ash: alerting 1: tight tail latency increase on embeddings in eu-west1 after last quant rollout. small error bump. recommending emergency pin and batch tweak.
kai: can you attach the telemetry?
ash: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embeds?region=eu-west1 spike at 21:05 UTC correlates w/ image embed:v2.3.2-quant.
product_ops: need a short rollout + rollback plan and approvals. ops + oncall please ack.
sre_oncall: I'll approve a staged canary if rollback is ready and we monitor p95/p99 + 5xx.
ash: proposal: pin image -> embed:v2.2.7 in eu-west1 only; adjust batch window to 25ms. rollout plan: 1% -> 10% -> 100% manual gates. owner = kai.
kai: infra OK for staged. I'll own the run.
ash: draft release note:
```
Hotfix (expedite): revert embeddings image from v2.3.2-quant to v2.2.7 in eu-west1 and reduce batching window to 25ms to address p99 tail latency increase.
```
product_ops: changelog entry queued. billing tag: expedited-hotfix.
deploybot: @kai scheduled deploy id=dr-1764132468-z. strategy=staged-canary slices=[1%,10%,100%] checks=[health,p95,p99,5xx]; manual approval required between stages.
sre_oncall: abort criteria: 5xx > 0.5% OR p99 increases > 20% sustained for 5m.
kai: starting canary 1%. logs: dr-1764132468-z start.
kai: 6m: p95 -14%, p99 -19%, 5xx steady. approve 10%.
deploybot: progressing to 10% slice.
product_ops: alerting sales for any impacted customers, posting status page note "mitigation underway, no downtime expected".
kai: 12m at 10% stable. proceeding to 100%.
deploybot: deploy complete dr-1764132468-z -> 100% status=success.
sre_oncall: monitoring for 30m post-deploy.
ash: rollback command (one-liner):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/embeddings --to-revision=deploy-v2.3.2-quant && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeddings -n prod
```
product_ops: marking this hotfix as critical/expedited. will open RCA ticket and follow-up with regression tests for long-seq quant paths.
kai: closing thread, will post link to runbook and RCA when available. :thumbsup:
